name: manual_4e6559
claim: Treat ECC upstream advancement and local-overlay restoration as separate idempotent steps: verify the upstream SHA, accept a clean reviewed checkout, restore every approved patch path, and report success only after restoration.

decisions.notes: A current submodule HEAD does not prove local-only files or additive hunks are present. The 2026-08-14 regression verified clean and repeated upgrade behavior across both overlay modes.

rationale: A current submodule HEAD does not prove local-only files or additive hunks are present. The 2026-08-14 regression verified clean and repeated upgrade behavior across both overlay modes.
